# Staying up: jobs, health & data

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-blocks.mjs from scripts/blocks-meta.json. Edit that file, not this one. -->

### Background jobs
- What: Run slow work outside the user's request, so the screen answers at once.
- Applies when: some work the user does not watch takes longer than a few seconds, such as sending email, importing a file or building a report.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: checkable
- Proof: test
- Done when: Slow work the user does not watch runs outside the request. The user gets an immediate response and can see whether the job finished or failed.

### Dead-letter queue
- What: A place where jobs that keep failing are set aside for a person to look at.
- Applies when: background jobs fail under real use.
- Stage: with-users
- Kind: checkable

### Idempotent ingest
- What: Process each incoming message from another system only once, even if it arrives twice.
- Applies when: the app receives messages from other systems.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: checkable
- Proof: test
- Done when: The same incoming message delivered twice is processed once.

### Checkpoints
- What: Save progress in long jobs, so a restart continues instead of starting over.
- Applies when: jobs run for many minutes.
- Stage: with-users
- Kind: checkable

### Health probes
- What: A simple address that reports whether the app and what it depends on are working.
- Applies when: the app is live and depends on outside services.
- Stage: with-users
- Kind: checkable

### Heartbeats
- What: Regular still-alive signals from background workers, so a silent failure gets noticed.
- Applies when: background workers run unattended.
- Stage: with-users
- Kind: checkable

### Race conditions
- What: Bugs where two things happening at once give the wrong result, such as selling the last seat twice.
- Applies when: two requests can change the same thing at once, such as stock, seats or a balance.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: checkable
- Proof: test
- Done when: Two requests at the same moment for the last item: exactly one succeeds. A test fires them together.

### Optimistic locking
- What: Detect when two people edited the same record, instead of one silently overwriting the other.
- Applies when: two people can edit the same record.
- Stage: with-users
- Kind: checkable

### Backups & restore drills
- What: Copy the data regularly, and practise restoring it so you know it works.
- Applies when: the app is going live with data worth keeping.
- Stage: go-live
- Kind: checkable
